raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 60 customers migrated from the new CRM on 2026-01-15 carry numeric region codes ('01'-'04') instead of region names. raw_region_map, which the CRM note says lists these codes, maps each code to a unique name, so silver_customers can resolve them with a left join and keep the original value for any unmapped region.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(m.region_name, upper(c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON c.region = m.region_code;"}}
